_doc: AA-1170: the repos and workflow names the root compliance collector reads (tools/compliance/collect.py).
No threshold lives here: the limits that grade a check (drill age, access review age, overdue docs, validity,
heartbeat) are CIS admin settings (cis.compliance.*). guard_window_days is the read window of the scheduled
guard check (which runs count as the latest), the same window as tools/github/guard_runs.py. ci_runs_inspected is
how many recent CI runs per image repo the scan check reads to find the newest one that scanned (an API read bound;
the age a scan may have is the CIS setting cis.compliance.ci_scan_max_age_days).
AA-1174: legal_docs lists the docs/legal pages each legal document check reads (front matter last_reviewed,
review_every_days, status; CIS grades the published `overdue` count); retention_log is the run log whose
live erasure drill rows date the last_erasure_drill check. legal_draft_status: a legal page in one of these
front-matter statuses is not an adopted document, so its check fails (a definition, not a threshold).
